newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Stahl 96 profits down, cuts dividend.
newsitem.headline: VA Stahl 96 profits down, cuts dividend.

text.p: Austrian steelmaker VA Stahl reported a drop in 1996 group net profit to 1.688 billion schillings from 3.071 billion on Thursday and said it was cutting its dividend to 12 schillings from 13 in 1995.
In a statement, VA Stahl said pre-tax profit fell to 2.031 billion schillings from 3.257. It forecast its 1997 earnings would be in line with 1996.

"Overall VA Stahl expects its result this year will be as good as in 1996, based on more stable market conditions," VA Stahl said, adding it expected steady to slightly higher prices and a positive sales development in all key production areas.
The firm posted 1996 earnings before interest and tax of 1.695 billion schillings, down from 3.044 billion. Sales fell to 31.5 billion schillings from 33.8 billion.
"VA Stahl's first full business year after its stock exchange listing was characterised by an unfavourable market environment," said the firm, which made its bourse debut in October 1995.
Raw steel production fell 11 percent in 1996 to 4.05 million tonnes. European steel consumption fell seven percent as budget cuts across the bloc curtailed public investment.
"In some product groups prices fell to levels last seen in 1993. The downturn only bottomed out in the fourth quarter," VA Stahl said.
Cost-cutting measures had brought annual savings of 3.4 billion schillings compared with 1993. VA Stahl said it was aiming for further annual savings of 500 million schillings in the medium term.

Investments in new equipment reached 4.5 billion schillings in 1996 and would rise to more than 13 billion by the turn of the century. VA Stahl, which has said its next financial year will end on March 31 1998, forecast investments of 4.7 billion schillings in 1997/98.
VA Stahl said it hoped to strike a cooperation deal in central and eastern Europe this year.
"We are working on the basis that VA Stahl will take the industrial leadership in a partnership," the statement said, without giving further details.
